# Undistracted Me

> Undistracted Me is a free, open-source focus new tab for Chrome and Firefox: a Nepali (Bikram Sambat) calendar, site blocker, Pomodoro timer, ambient sounds, Google Tasks and quiet widgets. No account, works offline.

## Pages

- [Web app](https://app.undistracted.me/): The dashboard web app: open it in any browser.
- [Landing site](https://undistracted.me/): Product overview, FAQ, comparisons and download links.

## Install

- [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/undistracted-me/dfgbijakkhepoonhaelocdmcleeehmef)
- [Firefox Add-ons](https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/undistracted-me/)

- [Schema graph](https://app.undistracted.me/schema/page.json): JSON-LD knowledge graph.

- [Resource description](https://app.undistracted.me/.well-known/ard.json): Agentic Resource Description.
